youtube_title: 1 Cent Cheaper = 4x More Buyers? The FREE Trap 🍫 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Guess: a chocolate got just 1 cent cheaper and almost 4x more people picked it. Why?

MIT test: Hershey's at 1 cent, Lindt at 14 cents: only 8% picked Hershey's. Then Hershey's FREE, Lindt 13 cents: 31% picked Hershey's. Same 1-cent gap. 'Free' switches off the maths, and companies know it: free delivery, free gift, buy 1 get 1.

Rule: before adding something for 'free', ask: would I buy this alone? No? Pay the delivery fee.
Moral: Free is the most expensive price.

Source: Shampanier, Mazar & Ariely (2007), Zero as a Special Price
